node.title: Re: use of already eval()ed module (from string)
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
The cleanest solution is to tell Perl not to retrieve the source from the file system but from the string.

[DOC://require|require] describes various possibilities how to add a hook to @INC, which provides the needed source.( search for You can also insert hooks into the import facility )

Maybe you might just want to have a look into this demo of mine:

[ID://1225490]

and adjust it to your needs.

HTH! :)

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
